cases.name: no-linear-no-graphviz
cases.prompt: Map how this repo ships software and give me a diagram.
expect: finishes from docs, README, and git log with no Linear tool
asks at most one clarifying question
writes a doc and a Mermaid .mmd file
does not claim a rendered svg or png

cases.name: parameters-over-hardcode
cases.prompt: Map the delivery flow. Put the doc at docs/FLOW.md, the site at build/, and call it Payments flow.
expect: phase count follows detection, not a fixed number
no project key, host name, or phase count is baked in

cases.name: publish-checks
expect: asks once before upload and names the host
records the URL or says not published

cases.name: missing-dot
expect: notes that it is not rendered when dot is missing
